No Excuse Absentee Polling Places

No Excuse Absentee Voting is an in-person absentee option for all voters during the two weeks before each election. No absentee voting excuse is necessary, and you do not need to apply for a ballot. You can cast your vote at any of the locations below. Call libraries to confirm hours of operations.

Hours for Carpenter Library, Kingshighway Branch Library, and Walnut Park Library No Excuse Absentee Voting Locations:

  • Monday: 1 PM-4PM
  • Tuesday-Thursday: 11AM-5PM

  • Sunday: Closed

  • Friday and Saturday: 11 AM-4:30 PM
